context_scope: No explicit CUDA context initialization, context query, warmup or extra orbital evaluation. The first CUDA construction may include first context/library costs; all later samples reuse the process context but create/destroy a fresh ephemeris workspace. Imported Python modules and catalogue parsing are shared setup measured separately.
physical_scope: Orbital-state parity thresholds and archive representation bounds only; project trajectory/certificate/fleet gates are not changed or evaluated.
timing_scope: Each CUDA sample calls the actual frozen prepare_route_states, including key deduplication, construction/element upload, host batch/download, destruction and returned dictionary. CPU samples call frozen body_state twice per flown leg without a state cache. File writes/comparisons are outside timers. Both include small observer/counter overhead.
